name: SurvIQ
summary: Survey and form builder with cross-tab analysis, AI to write surveys and summarise answers, and a free plan; also has a thesis mode and 360 feedback.
best_for: freelancers, consultants, small teams and students who want a survey builder with built-in cross-tab analysis and AI summaries without paying for every feature separately
skip_if: you need to know the annual price up front, you need more than 5,000 responses a month on a fixed plan, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: The free plan allows only 50 responses a month and 3 active surveys, and the page shows 33% introductory discounts that end after 3 months. Annual prices are not shown on the page text we read.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · 1,000 responses a month and 1 user
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-10 on surviqapp.com/en, US dollars) SurvIQ has a Free plan with 50 responses a month, 1 user and up to 3 active surveys. Basic costs $9 a month for 1,000 responses and 1 user, Pro costs $29 a month for 5,000 responses and 3 users, and Business costs $79 a month for 25,000 responses and 10 users. Until 31 December the page shows 33% off the monthly plans for the first 3 months ($6.03, $19.43 and $52.93), applied at checkout with no code; those are introductory prices, so plan on the full monthly price after that. The page also advertises 2 months free on annual billing, but we did not see the annual amounts. If you do not want a subscription, prepaid credits run from $5 for 100 responses to $79 for 5,000 responses and never expire, and you can buy a tier once: Basic for $45 or Pro for $145, each with a monthly response quota. A Thesis Pass costs US$19, shown at US$9.50 until 31 December, for 12 months and one project. The page says you can try Pro free for 7 days. We did not open checkout, so the tax added is not known.
